result.note: Brief item on Nepal's stance on mediation in its border dispute with India; tested the outcome and the countries the Prime Minister had proposed.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about Nepal's border dispute with India as of June 2026:
items: In June 2026, Nepal agreed to involve foreign mediators in resolving the dispute.
Nepal's Prime Minister Balen Shah had suggested involving China and the United Kingdom in the dispute.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 1 is wrong: on 8 June 2026 Nepal ruled out foreign mediators in the dispute. This completed a week-long climbdown from Prime Minister Balen Shah's suggestion of bringing in China and the United Kingdom.
questions.source: Nepal ruled out foreign mediators in its border dispute with India, completing a week-long climbdown from Prime Minister Balen Shah's suggestion of involving China and the United Kingdom.
